name: @vouchstone/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Vouchstone (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle assets --output src/.bundled/assets.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle assets --output src/.bundled/assets.json && redocly bundle evidence --output src/.bundled/evidence.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle evidence --output src/.bundled/evidence.json && redocly bundle domains --output src/.bundled/domains.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle domains --output src/.bundled/domains.json && redocly bundle coverage --output src/.bundled/coverage.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle coverage --output src/.bundled/coverage.json && redocly bundle attribution --output src/.bundled/attribution.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle attribution --output src/.bundled/attribution.json && redocly bundle exercises --output src/.bundled/exercises.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle exercises --output src/.bundled/exercises.json && redocly bundle findings --output src/.bundled/findings.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle findings --output src/.bundled/findings.json && redocly bundle allocation --output src/.bundled/allocation.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle allocation --output src/.bundled/allocation.json && redocly bundle assurance --output src/.bundled/assurance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle assurance --output src/.bundled/assurance.json && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.json
